scope: Entire rewritten unpublished branch payload; manifest and review excluded from their own inventory
excluded: third-party README/eval/loader source copies; permission unverified
history_policy: Single unpublished commit amended from the unchanged published base. Prior unpublished commit preserved only under a private ref; publish only the exact reproduction branch, never private refs or mirror/all-refs.
limitations: Pattern scan does not establish arbitrary secret absence or dataset label correctness. Original published base is unchanged.
